title: Discovery of Minamata disease
summary: In May 1956 methylmercury poisoning, later called Minamata disease, was first officially discovered in Minamata City among residents around Minamata Bay of the Shiranui Sea in Kumamoto Prefecture. Waste water from the Chisso chemical plant was identified as its source.

importance.justification: The outbreak became a landmark case of industrial pollution causing human disease.

audience_note: Describes a mass poisoning from industrial pollution that harmed residents' health; this record gives no clinical detail.
